items.title: Keep MDX archive and runtime article registry synchronized
items.next_action: Keep the editorial integrity CI gate green on the latest exact PR head after every relaunch-control change.
items.done_when: Every public article has one matching MDX record and runtime registry entry with unique slug/record ID, matching dates, required source metadata, and green exact-head CI.

items.title: Remove release-wide date placeholders from article metadata, RSS and sitemap
items.next_action: Keep the date paths covered by exact-head build and editorial integrity checks.
items.done_when: A newly added article automatically emits its own correct published/modified dates across article metadata, JSON-LD, RSS and sitemap.

items.title: Prove newsletter subscription and send path end to end
items.next_action: Verify the intended production D1 migration/binding, choose the actual sending provider, document unsubscribe/suppression behavior, then run one internal test address only after human approval.
items.done_when: Subscription storage, provider sync/import, unsubscribe, one internal delivery, and send receipt are all verified on the intended production path.

items.title: Make submission intake operational rather than mail-only
items.next_action: Choose a monitored intake backend/workflow that keeps personal or confidential submissions out of the public repository; then add an acknowledgement and triage receipt path.
items.done_when: A normal submission can be received, acknowledged, classified, assigned and tracked without publishing sender PII or confidential material.

items.title: Implement privacy-preserving relaunch analytics
items.next_action: Select an analytics storage/provider path and implement only the approved event taxonomy with normalized public identifiers and no free-text/PII payloads.
items.done_when: Exact-revision production receipts prove allowed events arrive with the specified schema and forbidden fields are absent.

items.title: Complete one private audio dry run
items.next_action: Take one already-approved record through script, fact check, rights check, recording, edit and transcript QA; stop before upload.
items.done_when: A locally retained audio master, transcript and QA packet exist for one approved record without any public release.

items.title: Maintain a claims-safe sponsor inventory
items.next_action: Record only verified prospect/discussion state; do not add public partner/sponsor language until a commitment is confirmed and approved.
items.done_when: Every real sponsor/prospect thread has a dated owner, state, next action, terms status, editorial-conflict review and claim authority.

items.title: Run exact-release-candidate public smoke checklist
items.next_action: After the launch candidate is fixed, run CI plus home/article/search/newsletter/submit/corrections/standards/RSS/sitemap/robots smoke checks on that same immutable revision.
items.done_when: All P0 checks are green and deployment attribution points to the exact verified source revision.

items.title: Resolve canonical public origin and exact-revision deployment attribution
items.next_action: Choose one authoritative public origin, bind it to one deployed immutable source revision, update public profiles and generated canonical/RSS/sitemap origins to the same URL, then collect live smoke receipts from that exact revision.
items.done_when: One public origin resolves the approved revision and public profiles, canonical metadata, RSS, sitemap and smoke-test receipts all agree on the same origin and source SHA.
